image_description: A large, adult common iguana resting horizontally on a patch of green grass. The subject is viewed from the side (profile). It has a prominent dorsal crest running down its spine, rough textured skin with greyish-brown and tan coloration, and a long tail extending to the left. The head is visible on the right, showing a large subtympanic shield and a closed or squinting eye. Shadows from trees or structures fall across the grass and the lizard's body.
